findings: Design conflict: prompt asks for hand near the shoulder, validator forbids any change in the top 20% of the figure
UX gap: rejection reason not shown on the card
Workaround: keep the counting hand at chest height, fingertips below the shoulder line (in Lina's canvas below y~380 of 1536); scroll to the top message after a failed drop to read the reason

resolution.root_cause: Front gesture validator's head-zone silhouette check rejects raised-hand gestures that the slot prompts themselves request; reason displayed off-screen.
resolution.fix_applied: Phase 53: colour-based gesture head check (GESTURE_HEAD_KEPT 0.75) and refusal reason on the slot card
